sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Vengeful Killa is a Scav Boss in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Killa earned his reputation back in the days of the Contract Wars, when he and his crew took over the ULTRA shopping mall. For most locals, that mask with the three stripes means death. For a select few, it's a reminder of wild dubstep parties somewhere on the city's edge.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Vengeful Killa has different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
| Stats |
| Head: 80; Thorax: 260; Stomach: 180; Arms: 100 each; Legs: 120 each; Total: 960 |
- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 double slot pockets, bringing their total space to 10 slots.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Vengeful Killa can be found in The Labyrinth. He appears after the death of Shadow of Tagilla.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: Vengeful Killa uses a light machine gun or other automatic weapon to suppress the enemy, while lurking from cover to cover, getting closer to his target for the final push.
